milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The cobblestone stairs are placed at spawn-relative positions (5, 0-3, 3-6). The target is set to (5, 1, 4) — the second stair block near the base — with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60. This models the player spotting and looking toward the staircase from a reasonable distance, which is the natural behavior for a 'find' task.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The dark_oak_logs are on the elevated platform at spawn-relative (4-6, 4-6, 8). The target is (5, 5, 8) — the middle of the vertical log trunk. max_distance is set to 4 (tightened from 5 per CommonSenseAgent and ValidatorAgent feedback) to robustly enforce the climbing dependency: from ground level at (5, 0, 8) the 3D distance is 5.0 — safely outside the 4-block threshold; from the platform at (5, 3, 8) the distance is only 2.0 — easily within range. This ensures the player must climb the cobblestone stairs to the platform to complete this milestone.
